image_description:
## 1. Chart type
- **Time-series line chart with point markers** (annual values connected by a line).

## 2. Layout techniques
- **Single-panel chart** (no faceting or small multiples).
- Uses **point markers connected by lines**.
- Uses **color to distinguish warmer vs. cooler anomalies** relative to a baseline.
- Includes **text annotations/labels** for selected years.

## 3. Data variables

| Data Variable | Type of Variable | Visual Encoding |
|---|---|---|
| Year | Temporal | Position on x-axis; text labels for selected years |
| Temperature difference from late-19th-century average (annual anomaly, °C) | Quantitative | Position on y-axis; connected line; point position |
| Relative temperature status (warmer vs. cooler than 1880–1899 average) | Categorical/nominal | Color/hue of points (warm peach vs. cool blue/neutral) |
| Selected highlighted year values (e.g., 1904, 1944, 1998, 2016, 2018) | Temporal | Direct text labels/annotations near points |
